article.title: Crow markets in everything the labor supply-boosting culture that is Sweden
article.excerpt: The crows turn in their collected cigarette butts for food: Over in the Swedish city of Södertälje, about 30 km southwest of Stockholm, a pilot program is being explored which will enlist crows to clean up discarded cigarette butts .
